1.

It was the night, O Lord, When all strove To cast the shadows of darkness Upon Thy holy mind, Thy voice of love we hear: Do this in remembrance of Me! With thankful hearts’ response We now may remember Thee.

2.

We think upon the darkness That closed around Thy spirit, Upon those deep waves That then broke over Thee. O, there Thy grace immeasurable, Thy love’s depth we see, And give thankful response In Thy remembrance.

3.

Until Thou, O Lord, comest And callest us to Thyself, To rest in Thy presence, A cloudless day with Thee, We may proclaim Thy death With longing inward, That we may become more like it, In that we remember Thee.
